text:
Maria: Heads-up: I ran the med-variant routing A/B yesterday and saw batch sizes drop on multi-variant endpoints. Quick log + profiling below.

Ash: Which endpoint and can you paste the profiler output?

Maria: /chat/generate (mix: r-lama-7b / r-lama-ql4 / open-variant). Kernel selection shifted to generic matmul on Q4 runs. snippet: `kernel_choice: matmul_generic` and `avg_batch_size: 2.1 -> 1.3`

Joel: Oof. That sounds like compat-set fragmentation. Did the fallback policy change? We recently lowered token_budget target for fairness.

Maria: Yes — token_budget_target bumped down from 256 to 128 for per-queue smoothing. Queue policy now aggressively slices to keep latency tail low.

Kim: Share p99 latency and KV hitrate?

Maria: p50 steady, p99 spiked from 210ms -> 410ms. KV-cache hit-rate for prefix cache dropped 78% -> 43% on that endpoint. Profiler trace: `batch_formation_hist: [1: 63%, 2: 25%, 3+: 12%]`

Ash: That kv drop explains kernel fallback: small batch -> different kernel path -> extra memcpy + kernel selection overhead. Can you run `./scripts/trace-kv.sh --endpoint '/chat/generate' --since 8h` and paste trace id?

perf-bot: trace started: id=trc-2115551111-7a9

Maria: trace id trc-2115551111-7a9 uploaded. Key findings: compatibility routing prefers variant with smaller KV-key prefix match; we get cross-variant fanout. Batching scheduler now interleaves and forms microbatches per variant, so effective batch size per kernel is tiny.

Joel: Possible mitigations: 1) increase token_budget_target for that queue to 192; 2) relax compatset strictness to allow pooling similar variants; 3) sticky-routing for short prefix matches. Which one to try first?

Kim: I vote (2) relax compatset. Change match threshold from 0.90 -> 0.85, see if kernel grouping improves. Low risk and no-cost config change. :+1:

Ash: Also add a sampling probe to measure kernel selector decisions: `runtime.kernel_probe.enable=true` + `runtime.kernel_probe.window=5m` — that'll give us per-kernel counts.

Maria: I'll flip compat threshold in staging and run an A/B test. If no improvement I'll float token_budget_target back up to 192. cc @perf-bot to run periodic profiling.

perf-bot: scheduled: nightly perf run for endpoint '/chat/generate' w/ compat_th=0.85 vs baseline (traces: trc-2115551111-7a9 baseline, trc-2115552222 candidate)

Joel: :thumbsup: One more ask — add an instrumentation metric `batch_kernel_group_size` exported to console so ops can see per-kernel batch sizes.

Maria: On it. I'll update dashboard and share results tomorrow. Thanks!
